from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityClassData(BaseModel):
    """One university's CDS report data on undergraduate class sizes."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the university")
    sections_100_plus: int | None = Field(description="Number of undergraduate class sections with 100+ students in this university")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period (e.g., Fall 2021)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    universities: list[UniversityClassData]
